overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the University of Washington men's soccer team on winning the 2025 NCAA Division I national championship, the first national title in the program's history. It notes the team's 3-2 overtime win over North Carolina State in the final and that it became the first team to win six road games in the tournament after ending the regular season on a losing streak. The resolution recognizes the players, coaches and staff and asks that copies be sent to the head coach, athletic director and university president. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 8, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a fitting way to recognize the hard work and achievement of student-athletes and their school.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending.
